meta.name: Satyameva
meta.description: Sathyameva follows Advocate Rajaram, a washed-up defense lawyer haunted by his past failure to save an innocent client. When a dying man dismissed by everyone as mad begs him to find a daughter who vanished 20 years ago, Rajaram takes on the case. Filing a habeas corpus petition, his investigation leads him through an orphanage and an old, buried police file, uncovering dark secrets that powerful figures want to keep hidden. Through intense courtroom battles, the search for the missing woman becomes Rajaram's ultimate shot at justice and personal redemption.

videos.title: Death at the Courthouse
videos.overview: A shocking suicide by a stranger at the courthouse changes Advocate Rajaram's life forever.

videos.title: Truth on Trial
videos.overview: Guided by the law, Rajaram begins his investigation to uncover the truth behind the case.

videos.title: The Battle of Arguments
videos.overview: Rajaram presents a father's relentless fight for long-denied justice before the court.

videos.title: A Hidden Identity Unveiled
videos.overview: Amrutha's true identity and hidden past finally unfold before the court.

videos.title: The Truth Resurfaces
videos.overview: Every attempt by the opposing side to conceal the facts fails as the court begins to see the reality Rajaram has uncovered.

videos.title: Justice Served
videos.overview: Rajaram secures justice for Amrutha and her late father Vijayan, ensuring those who ruined her life are punished.
